name: symbolic-clippath
title: Symbolic Clip Path
description: A two-row gallery of six colour-washed tiles, each framing a surreal painting inside a different cut-out shape: a star, an arrow, a horseshoe, a quarter disc and more.
use: An art, culture or portfolio page wants a gallery with unusual shapes rather than plain squares.
avoid: Photos are pulled from Unsplash with empty alt text, and the fixed 3-column grid gets cramped on phones.
a11y: All six images have empty alt text and the grid has no captions; hover motion ignores prefers-reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Six square tiles sit in a three-by-two grid, each on a warm or muted gradient ground. Inside each, a richly painted scene is clipped to a distinct silhouette: a pointed star, a four-way arrow, a two-lobed horseshoe, a curved wedge, a tall tree and a picture-frame outline.
behaves: On hover a tile's padding shrinks and its clipped picture eases slightly larger, so the shape swells toward the tile edges. The shapes stay fixed; only the inner image and its margin change.
customise: Six image URLs and their matching clip-path ids are hardcoded, as are the tile gradients; adding items means editing the grid and defining a new shape.
weight: light: Six images and CSS transitions on padding and scale; nothing loops.
